current_evidence: The council's 'Submit a planning application' page (article/8293) links only to the web document 'Planning validation requirements' (article/37046), not the PDF. That document's 'Validation checklist' section (article/37122) has 44 numbered items, including a new item 19 'Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMO) Checklist and Management Plan' that is not in the 43-item July 2025 PDF, so the web version is newer. The web version shows no date.

issues.detail: The PDF still opens and is dated 'July 2025' in its text, but the council's planning pages no longer link to it. The live checklist is the web document at article/37046 (checklist section article/37122). It has been revised since the PDF: it adds item 19 'HMO Checklist and Management Plan' and renumbers items 19 to 43 as 20 to 44.
issues.evidence: Submit a planning application page links 'Planning validation requirements' (article/37046). Web checklist: '19. Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMO) Checklist and Management Plan ... 44. Visual Impact Assessment'. PDF: 43 items, 19 = Hydrogeological Risk Assessment.

issues.detail: The List date 2025-07-01 is taken from the PDF's CreationDate metadata. The PDF text does say 'July 2025', so the month is right for that PDF, but it is not the date of the current web checklist, which shows no date. The 'Planning page' field is the council homepage, not the validation page.
issues.evidence: PDF title 'Planning Validation Requirements', dated July 2025; article/37046 shows no date or version.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured about 25 requirements, but the source lists 43 in the PDF (44 on the web). Requirements missing from app_type_rows: Active Travel Audit (residential 10+ units or 1ha outline; 5,000 sqm employment/leisure; ATE toolkit at 150 dwellings, 7,500 sqm or 5ha+); Air Quality Assessment (screening: 10+ units or 0.5ha+ residential, 1,000 sqm+ or 1ha+ other, with parking or centralised energy, or conflict with an AQAP); Building for Life Assessment (residential 50+ units or 1.5ha+ outline); Construction Management Plan (detailed major proposals with sensitive receptors within 100m); Glint and Glare Assessment (large grid-connected solar, Fishburn/Shotton-Peterlee safeguarding areas, tracking panels); HMO Checklist and Management Plan (new web item 19); Hydrogeological Risk Assessment (mineral, landfill and landraise applications); Internal Space Standards Assessment (C3/C4 residential, excluding C3 to C4); Minerals and/or Waste Infrastructure Assessment (in or adjoining a minerals or waste safeguarding zone); Minerals Assessment (in or adjoining a Mineral Safeguarding Area); Noise Assessment (noise-generating or noise-sensitive development); Open Space, Sport, Play and Leisure Assessment (creation or loss of open space; all major housing); Soil Resource Management Strategy (1ha+ not on previously developed land); Structural Survey (conversions such as barns, listed buildings, substantial demolition of heritage assets); Telecommunications Assessment (all telecoms applications); Transport Statement (C3 50 to 80 units, 30+ two-way peak movements, 100+ daily, 100+ parking spaces, AQMA etc.); Tree and Hedgerow Assessment (mature or semi-mature trees or hedges on or adjacent to the site that could be affected); Ventilation/Extraction Statement (substantial ventilation or extraction equipment); Visual Impact Assessment (all majors; WHS, North Pennines AONB and Heritage Coast; all solar farms and wind turbines). The local Design and Access Statement thresholds (item 5) are also not captured.

Several requirements carry the trigger text of a different checklist item. (1) 'Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment' under Outline carries the Building for Life trigger ('All residential developments of 50+ units or 1.5ha+ if outline'); the real trigger is development in a Coal Mining High Risk Area, with householder, reserved matters and others exempt. (2) 'Employment / Economic Statement' carries the Active Travel Audit text ('5000 sqm employment land / leisure proposals ... Active Travel Audit'); no employment statement exists in the list. (3) 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' carries the Lighting Assessment floodlighting text. (4) 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' carries the Agricultural Land Classification text; the list has no rural workers' dwelling item. (5) 'Transport Assessment' carries ALC text ('Any development on land of 1ha or more ... agriculture'), not its use-class thresholds (e.g. C3 over 80 units, B8 over 5,000 sqm, food retail over 800 sqm). (6) 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' carries the town centre uses sequential test text, which has nothing to do with flood risk.
issues.evidence: Coal Mining row excerpt: 'Life Assessment Coal Mining Risk Assessment ... All residential developments of 50+ ... units or 1.5ha+ if outline'. PDF item 13: Coal Mining Risk Assessment, development in Coal Mining High Risk Areas.

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are column-interleaved, truncated, or describe what to include rather than when the item applies. Examples: Affordable Housing Statement ('in An affordable Housing Statement shall identify: West Durham to provide an'; actual: major housing, and 5+ units in West Durham); BNG ('or where a biodiversity net gain - specification'.'; actual: most development, householder and de minimis exempt); Drainage/SuDS ('should include Sustainable Drainage Systems (SUDs) details.'; actual: 10+ dwellings or 0.5ha+ residential, 1,000 sqm+ or 1ha+ non-residential); FRA (gives only 1ha+ and omits Flood Zones 2/3 and vulnerable changes of use); Contaminated Land, Ecological Survey and Heritage Statement give content or method text, not triggers; HIA and Housing mix excerpts are interleaved with policy columns; Photographs/Photomontages ('using 15 photomontages or artist's impressions.') is a fragment of the Visual Impact Assessment row.
issues.evidence: PDF items 11, 21, 24, 34 and the app_type_rows trigger_excerpt fields.

issues.detail: Almost every requirement is marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' (for example BNG, Heritage Statement, Viability). Meanwhile application types the source names explicitly show '(none)'. Listed building consent shows '(none)', but DAS (item 5), Heritage Statement (item 18) and Structural Survey (item 33) are expressly required for LBC. Householder shows '(none)', but Heritage Statement (in or next to a conservation area), DAS (CA/WHS over 100 sqm), Tree and Hedgerow Assessment and Levels apply. Minerals & waste shows '(none)', but Hydrogeological Risk Assessment, Minerals/Waste Infrastructure Assessment and Minerals Assessment apply. Variation of condition s73 shows '(none)', but a Planning Statement is required for variation or removal of conditions. 'Travel Plan' is placed under Outline only because the text mentions an 'Outline' Travel Plan type.
issues.evidence: PDF item 5: 'listed building consent'; item 18: 'Listed building consent'; item 19: 'Mineral, landfill, and landraise applications'; item 30: 'condition variation/removal'.

issues.detail: Most of the 12 tab_items are fragments, process text or references rather than requirements. They include: 'This information can be placed within the site layout plan...'; 'If preferred this can be detailed within... floor plans'; 'Gov.uk - Fire statement form.pdf Applications for planning permission will be exempt... where:'; the email format rule 'If plans are being emailed... .pdf or .tif format' (repeated in 3 items); 'NPPF Part 15 CDP Policies 29, 40'; 'DCC Tree Management Policy and ... SPD.pdf and (2024) See:'; 'D Special Areas of Conservation ... Outline details of the habitat management over the 30-year period;'; and the bare heading 'Nutrient Neutrality and Mitigation :'.
issues.evidence: tab_items in sections 'Drawing / document standards', 'Submission rules' and 'Policy-driven requirements'.

issues.detail: Pairs of rows share one identical trigger: 'Flood Risk Assessment' and 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' (both use the item 34 FRA text); 'Agricultural Land Classification' and 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' (both use the ALC text); 'Retail / Town Centre Impact' and 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' (both use the item 31 town centre text). The email-format sentence appears 3 times in tab_items.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows trigger_excerpt fields are identical for each pair.

summary: Grokbot read a real Durham list (the July 2025 PDF), but the council now publishes a revised 44-item web checklist (article/37122) that adds an HMO item, so the PDF link is outdated. Extraction is poor: about 19 of the 43 to 44 items are missing, several triggers belong to the wrong item (for example, Coal Mining shows the Building for Life threshold), and LBC, householder, minerals and s73 rows wrongly show no local requirements.
